title: Dominic and the Letters Again
author: Sable Sterling
blurb: Marguerite Oyelaran, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must forgive the person in the mirror first before the festival ends.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
